parameters.reference_frame_kind: coordinate orbital triad; not radiation-defined coorbital frame
parameters.interpolation: cubic spline on each native horizon time grid; no extrapolation

protocol.peak_method: cubic spline of sum |h_lm|^2, all ell=2..4; local maximum refinement
protocol.normalization: NR already t/M, rh/M with ChMass=Mref; no second division
protocol.frame: all 21 NR modes passively rotated into coordinate orbital triad at reference epoch; not a calibrated radiation frame
protocol.sampling: linear interpolation on common support; no extrapolation
protocol.signal_kind: complex h22, two-sided PSD(|f|), global complex phase/time optimization
protocol.mass: detector-frame total mass; no redshift or distance inference
protocol.psd: white or historical LALAdvLIGOPsd analytic shape; not measured detector PSD
protocol.taper: symmetric Tukey; alpha scanned .02/.05/.1; long taper can suppress merger
protocol.display: baseline65Msun/20..512Hz/historicalPSD/alpha.02; unwindowed complex modes; optimized time and phase only, no amplitude scaling
protocol.start_frequency_diagnostic: median phase derivative over first100M; f_start<fmin necessary heuristic, not complete spectral support guarantee

limits: 外部归档对照，训练成员关系尚未核实，不能声称训练集外验证。
复 h22 模式失配不是探测器网络失配，也不能推出形成渠道概率。
坐标轨道框架近似与辐射框架误差尚未隔离；此处为近无自旋案例。
N2/N3/N4 是外推阶敏感性，不是分辨率收敛结果或统计误差条。
有限长度、渐消窗和频段会改变失配；起始频率诊断不保证完整低频支持。
